run_compare_profiles_cli: run the compare_profiles script to print summary timings for NVTX sqlite profile files in the working directory
run_compare_profiles_relative: run the compare_profiles script with the relative flag to display times relative to the first profile
run_compare_profiles_sort_exclusive: run the compare_profiles script sorted by exclusive time to compare NVTX event durations across profiles
get_sqlite_events: parse an sqlite database containing an NVTX_EVENTS table and return a list of Event objects
create_summary_from_events: create a summary dictionary grouped by event name with inclusive and exclusive timing from a list of events
